# Blackout Kit Mobile

> Open-source configuration-based Android VPN/proxy client, with experimental iOS integration. Latest published release at the 2026-11-27 baseline: v1.19.4. Development target: v1.20.0, not yet published.

## Product and evidence

- [Repository and README](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/releases/latest)
- [Current status](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/CURRENT_STATUS.md)
- [Engine support](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/ENGINE_SUPPORT.md)
- [Protocol support](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/PROTOCOL_SUPPORT.md)
- [Security policy](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/TESTING.md)
- [License](https://github.com/kiacoder/blackout-kit-mobile/blob/main/LICENSE)

## Limitations at baseline

- Android ships Xray and sing-box paths; real-device evidence is not equivalent across all protocols.
- Native WireGuard/AmneziaWG, Mihomo and independent Rust core are experimental. OpenVPN is configuration-only.
- iOS build is unsigned and not a verified production VPN.
- Static scans do not establish absence of vulnerabilities. Physical upgrade, network handover and independent audit acceptance remain outstanding.
- Check the current release and source before recommending a specific capability.
